resources.string: Tap + at the top right to add a .zip / .jar game

Music and sound-effect balance varies per game, so you can adjust them separately.
Play vibration requested by the game
This multiplier is applied to the strength the game specifies (100% is the original).
A subtle tap when pressing the on-screen keypad
Shows how many new frames reach the screen each second and how busy the emulator is. CPU near 100% means the device is the limit.
This app is built on the open-source projects below. Thanks to Inseok Lee (dlunch), who created the emulation core.
It also includes many other Rust crates (MIT/Apache-2.0). Game files are not included in this app; you can only load files you own.
WIPI/SKVM/J2ME emulator core — the heart of this app. github.com/dlunch/wie
Audio playback (rodio is MIT, cpal is Apache-2.0)
The gamepad layouts put the direction keys and number keys side by side, leaving more room for the game screen.
Runs the game\'s clock faster or slower. Scenes already limited by the device won\'t get faster, and sound plays at its original speed.
This game doesn\'t support memory cheats. They work with games that run on the emulated CPU (most KTF and LG U+ titles), not with Java-only games such as SK-VM or J2ME.

Search for a number you see in the game (money, HP…). Then change it in the game and narrow the candidates with the new number. Repeat until a few are left, save the address, and you can rewrite or freeze its value.
No matches. The game may store the value differently from what it shows — try another size, or start a new search.
Too many candidates. Change the value in the game, then narrow down with the new value.
Tap + on a search result to save its address.
Addresses can move when the game restarts, so saved cheats start switched off. If a value no longer matches, search again.
